en_title: With GTA 6's Dating System Incoming, a Surprising Percentage of Adults Think Investing in a Video Game Relationship Is Cheating
cn_title: 调查：6%认为游戏恋爱算出轨
subtitle: 像素恋情也算背叛？
opus_summary: 《GTA6》将于11月推出，双主角恋情是核心之一。YouGov调查了4,000名英国成年人，约6%认为游戏恋爱算出轨，另有19%虽不视为出轨，但仍无法接受。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is coming in November and focuses on a relationship between its dual protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The recent GTA 6 launch trailer featured three steamy intimate scenes in the shower, and, according to GTA 6 previews , Jason and Lucia can kiss at the touch of a button and are able to walk around holding hands. Screenshots suggest the pair can go on beach dates and shopping trips, and Rockstar has said that their relationship can blossom or wilt depending on how quickly you text back on the in-game mobile phones.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月推出，游戏围绕双主角Jason和Lucia之间的恋情展开。近期发布的《GTA6》发售预告片展示了三段火热的淋浴亲密戏。据游戏前瞻介绍，玩家只需按一下按钮，就能让Jason和Lucia接吻，两人还可以牵着手走路。游戏截图显示，两人似乎可以去海滩约会、一起购物。Rockstar也表示，玩家用游戏内手机回复短信的速度，会影响两人的感情是升温还是冷却。

paragraphs.en: That Bonnie and Clyde-style relationship is at the center of Rockstar’s upcoming game, and you’ll be able to engage with it as much or as little as you want. But you might want to speak to your romantic partner in real life first.
paragraphs.cn: 这段邦妮与克莱德式的恋情，是Rockstar这款新作的核心，玩家可以自行决定投入多少精力。不过，你或许最好先和现实中的伴侣聊一聊。

paragraphs.en: In September, British polling company YouGov asked 4,000 British adults whether they’d consider dating in a video game as cheating or not. Around 6% of respondents said they would consider it cheating, while a further 19% said that while they didn't consider it cheating, they wouldn’t be okay with it.
paragraphs.cn: 9月，英国民调公司YouGov询问了4,000名英国成年人，是否认为在电子游戏中谈恋爱算出轨。约6%的受访者认为算，另有19%表示，虽然不认为这算出轨，但仍然无法接受。

paragraphs.en: That’s a fairly surprising number of people who think smashing pixels together is some kind of betrayal. Women were considerably more against it than men. Only 4% of men would consider it cheating, while 7% of women would. Of those that didn’t consider it cheating but still weren’t okay with it, that was 13% of the men and 24% of the women asked.
paragraphs.cn: 竟有这么多人觉得，让像素角色亲热也算某种背叛，实在令人意外。女性对此的反对程度明显高于男性。只有4%的男性认为这算出轨，女性则有7%。至于不认为算出轨、但依然无法接受的受访者，男性中占13%，女性中占24%。

paragraphs.en: The BBC published an article on the poll, leading with a headline that was a question: can you cheat on someone with a video game character? This framing has led to a bit of backlash from players.
paragraphs.cn: BBC就这项民调发表了一篇文章，标题提出了一个问题：和电子游戏角色谈恋爱，算背叛伴侣吗？这种提问方式引起了一些玩家的反感。

paragraphs.en: “No, video game characters are not real, get a grip ffs!” said Stetson Spatula . “Can you get arrested for murdering someone on call of duty?” asked another X / Twitter user .
paragraphs.cn: Stetson Spatula表示：「不算，电子游戏角色又不是真人，拜托清醒点吧！」另一名X用户反问：「你在《使命召唤》里杀了人，难道还会被逮捕吗？」

paragraphs.en: A lot of the responses focused on established games such as The Sims, which let you live an alternative domestic life where your Sims marry, have children, and follow career paths while decking out their house. The perceived hypocrisy here is that players have been roleplaying relationships for a long time before GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 许多回复提到了《模拟人生》这样的老牌游戏。玩家可以在其中体验另一种家庭生活，让模拟市民结婚、生子、发展事业，同时装点自己的房子。在这些玩家看来，问题就在于这种双重标准：早在《GTA6》之前，玩家就已经在游戏中扮演恋人很多年了。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's potential for "cheating," has come up before. In August, we reported on how a swath of angry spouses on social media said they thought GTA 6's relationship mechanic was so in depth that it was equivalent to cheating on your real-life partner and worth breaking up over. Over on TikTok, for example, a number of concerned people said they wouldn't let their partner to play the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》可能涉及「出轨」的话题，此前就曾引发讨论。8月，我们曾报道，社交媒体上有不少愤怒的已婚人士表示，《GTA6》的恋爱机制太过深入，玩这套机制就相当于背叛现实中的伴侣，足以成为分手的理由。例如，TikTok上就有一些对此感到担忧的人表示，不会让自己的伴侣玩这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has also been very clear that you don't actually have to engage with this part of GTA 6 if you don't want to. Jason and Lucia want a relationship at the start of the game, but it's up to the player to actively pursue that. If you don't, they won't be as head-over-heels for each other, but will still have each other's backs when it matters most. If you do choose to make the two a power couple, you'll likely get more mileage out of the game, though.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar也明确表示，如果玩家不愿意，完全可以不参与《GTA6》的这部分内容。游戏开始时，Jason和Lucia都希望发展恋情，但是否主动推动这段关系，要由玩家决定。如果玩家不这么做，两人就不会那么痴迷于彼此，但在最关键的时刻仍会互相支持。不过，如果你选择让两人成为一对强强联手的情侣，很可能会从游戏中获得更多乐趣。

paragraphs.en: "When you bring them together, it feels like you’re a steward of their relationship, and you feel protective of them as a unit," Rockstar North co-studio head, Rob Nelson, told IGN. "But this is something we did not know when we started, and it really had to be something we felt our way through. But I will say that whether you’re getting in trouble, or you’re running from the cops, or getting in a car, or waiting for the other one — playing as them together feels very cool. It feels like you’re taking care of them, if that’s something you’re into."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar North工作室联席负责人Rob Nelson告诉IGN：「当你让他们走到一起时，会感觉自己在照料他们的感情，也会想要守护他们这对搭档。但我们刚开始时并不知道会有这种感觉，确实只能一路摸索。不过我想说，无论是惹上麻烦、逃避警察追捕、上车，还是等另一个人，让两人一起行动的感觉都非常酷。如果你喜欢这种体验，就会感觉自己在照顾他们。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar is currently pushing hard on the marketing front ahead of next month’s release. Last week saw real cars modified to look like GTA vehicles being driven around Miami.
paragraphs.cn: 随着游戏即将于下个月发售，Rockstar目前正大力展开营销宣传。上周，迈阿密街头出现了改装成《GTA》游戏车辆模样的真车。
